question: If x = acosec θ + b cot θ, y = bcosec θ + a cot θ, then what will be the value of x² – y²?–
solution:
**Given:**

x = acosec θ + b cot θ

y = b cosec θ + a cot θ

**Formula Used:**

cosec² θ - cot² θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ x² - y²

= (acosec θ + b cot θ)² - (b cosec θ + a cot θ)²

= a² cosec² θ + b² cot&
